input: Real emulator keyboard events via su sendevent event12: Default TalkBack keymap Alt+ArrowRight/Left and Alt+Enter. Native Back key returns. Fresh Appium session only observes a11y-focused=true and captures screenshots.
fixtures: Restored root-owned synthetic fixture: 3 book sources, 7 RSS sources (4 bundled web shortcuts), 1 synthetic book. No phone or user data.

checks.discoveryCategoryKeyboardReachAndActivat: passed: 完結 to 都市, selected category remains a11y focused; same page shows synthetic multi-source result
checks.rssCategoryKeyboardReachAndActivate: passed: 全部 to 本機UI驗收, selected category remains a11y focused; inline source-labelled articles
checks.myUpdateEntrance: passed: real TalkBack focus/activation to update page and Check for Updates button
checks.updateNetwork: unpublished metadata at test time returned retryable error; this is no download/install proof
checks.myFeedbackEntrance: passed: real TalkBack focus/activation to feedback page
checks.feedbackEditorAndSave: passed: editor and Save reached with TalkBack, Save activated via Alt+Enter; one synthetic record saved with local confirmation
checks.feedbackTextSetup: Appium set_value supplied synthetic text after TalkBack activated editor; no voice or hardware typing claim

limitations: Emulator has no audio: no acoustic listening or speech quality acceptance claimed.
This is bounded keyboard accessibility QA, not full human touch TalkBack acceptance.
Public in-app download/install not tested in this run; overlay preservation evidence recorded separately.
